item.title: 2 Minute Medicine Rewind September 21, 2026
item.description: A large case-control study across seven pediatric centers examines RSV-related hospitalizations among infants receiving nirsevimab.

item.title: Nanomedicine Aims to Precisely Target Fat Tissue
item.description: Nanoparticle-based therapies seek to deliver treatment directly into adipose tissue, offering a more targeted alternative to systemic GLP-1s.

item.title: Gut microbiome development may help predict type 1 diabetes in children at high risk
item.description: Type 1 diabetes affects more than 9 million people worldwide, including 1.8 million children and adolescents, and is thought to be driven by multiple factors.

item.title: Vitamin C linked to improved outcomes in people with precancerous blood disorders
item.description: Vitamin C boosts the activity of TET enzymes, which help regulate gene expression, and decreased function of these enzymes is implicated in certain conditions.
